## Raindrop Auto-Sorter

Runs every 15 minutes. Each new bookmark in the Inbox is sent to an LLM, which picks the collection it belongs in. Bookmarks the LLM isn't confident about go to the fallback collection, and you get a Telegram alert for each one.

## Setup (one time)
1. Create a Data Table named `collections` with columns: collection_id (number), name (text), description (text).
2. Add one row per collection. The description is what the LLM uses to choose it. Edit rows any time in the table view.
3. Raindrop token: create it in Raindrop under Settings > Integrations > Developer. In n8n, add a Header Auth credential on Get Inbox and Move Bookmark: Name Authorization, Value Bearer YOUR_TOKEN.
4. Run the Setup Form: Inbox ID, Fallback ID, Telegram chat ID, LLM settings, optional extra rules.
5. Credentials: LLM Request (Ollama: any value) and Send Summary (Telegram). Delete Send Summary if you don't want alerts.
6. Activate.

Example rows: 10000001 | Work | Job postings, client research. 10000004 | Unsorted | Fallback for anything uncertain.

## LLM Backend

Provider "ollama" (local default): URL http://ollama:11434/api/chat. Resolves only on your local network. Pull a model first, e.g. ollama pull qwen2.5:7b.

Provider "openai": any OpenAI-compatible chat API. URL example: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions. Key: Header Auth on LLM Request.

The LLM is asked for one bookmark at a time and returns a collection and a confidence score. Scores below the threshold (default 0.7, set in Config) go to the fallback.
